# Data Vault

> Sample-first data catalog by Matchbook Labs. Free CSV/JSON samples for every dataset, machine-readable index for agents, full packs sold via Getly.

Base URL: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault
Catalog (start here): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/catalog.json
Agent docs: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/agents/
MCP server: npx --allow-git=all -y github:jayjex/dataset-mcp (v1.1.3; tools: list_datasets, get_dataset_info, get_sample, query_dataset, get_stats; --allow-git=all needed on npm 12+, plain form on npm 10/11)
MCP repo: https://github.com/jayjex/dataset-mcp
MCP registry name: io.github.jayjex/dataset-mcp
Portfolio (all live work in one page: MCP server, DOIs, x402 API, 3D print, print-on-demand, writing): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/portfolio.html
Free printables index (223 free printable pages from the Matchbook Labs funnel, one link per live page): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/free-printables-index.html
Free printables by use case (same 223 pages regrouped into budget, moving, study and worksheet use cases): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/printable-index-roundup.html
Product catalog (all 90 public SKUs in one page: datasets, prompt packs, wallpapers and icons, bundles, spreadsheets, Notion templates, printable planners, books, dev tools, 2 free samples; prices and item counts as listed on each storefront; Fourthwall/SellApp/Getly links): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/products.html
MCP full query: query_dataset(slug, {where, columns, limit, offset}) filters and paginates the FULL released files, 100 rows/call. Example: query_dataset("hud-fmr-2026", {where: [{column: "state", op: "=", value: "TX"}], limit: 5}) returns 3,247 matched Texas rent rows. Full data release: https://github.com/jayjex/dataset-mcp/releases/tag/data-v1
FMR calculator guide (the math behind FMRs + MCP lookup, no official HUD calculator exists): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/hud-fair-market-rent-calculator.html
HUD income limits guide (AMI vs FMR, FY2026 30/50/80 percent limits parsed from huduser.gov files beside each metro's 2BR FMR): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/hud-income-limits.html
Landlord bookkeeping guide (track rental income and expenses around the IRS Schedule E categories: cash-basis income rules, the full expense line list, repair vs improvement, record retention): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/landlord-bookkeeping.html
HUD payment standard guide (the 90%-110% PHA band around the FMR, FY2026 band table for six ZIPs): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/hud-payment-standard.html
Payment standard for Section 8 guide (90%-110% FMR band, band computed from the FY2026 Abilene TX rows, 40% move-in cap example): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/fmr-payment-standard.html
SAFMR deep-dive (HUD's ZIP-level FMR: how it is computed, the 24 required + 41 added metro designations, San Diego intra-metro 2BR spread 3,040 dollars from the FY2026 file): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/safmr-small-area-fmr.html
HUD FMR metro definition guide (how HUD defines a metro FMR area, MSA vs HUD Metro FMR Area across the 649 metros, widest intra-metro 2BR spread worked from San Diego): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/hud-fmr-by-metro-area.html
HUD FMR 2027 guide (FY2027 rates effective October 1, 2026, 51,871 ZIP rows parsed from FY27_FMRs.xlsx + fy2027_safmrs.xlsx, median 2BR +3.30% YoY, Kingston NY +70.37% max, ZIP 76437 FY26-vs-FY27 side-by-side): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/hud-fmr-2027.html
Rent affordability guide (the 30% rule vs the FMR, five metros against the US median household income, FY2026): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/rent-affordability-calculator.html
Rent-to-income guide (how much rent can I afford: the 30% rule tested on FY2027 FMR + 2024 ACS data, national ratio 17.5% vs New York 39.6%, Miami, LA, SF, Boston against their own median incomes): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/rent-vs-income-affordability.html
HUD FMR vs market rent guide (FMR vs ACS median gross rent vs ZORI asking rent side by side, San Diego worked example: FMR 3,000 vs county ACS median 2,379, and why the percentile ordering reverses in fast markets): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/hud-fmr-vs-market-rent.html
What is llms.txt (plain-English definition of the format, how agents read the file, honest status): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/what-is-llms-txt.html
Dataset DOIs: twelve packs have permanent citable DOIs on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22643177 , https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22643149 , https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22643189 , https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22649503 , https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22665145 , https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22665925 , https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22666640 , https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22667164 , https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22667477 , https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22667657 , https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22676080 , https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22697115
FY2027 HUD FMR DOI (rates effective October 1, 2026): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22649503
Paid per-call API (x402 protocol, USDC on Base): the NFL scores and HUD FMR datasets are also queryable as paid x402 endpoints, $0.01/call NFL and $0.001/call HUD FMR, curl challenge replay + SDK snippet: https://gist.github.com/jayjex/9cb7cd0612b3192e06915f784e6d6e4a
Full content for LLM ingestion (this index expanded into one markdown file: README + 10 most-referenced dataset pages + 3 newest guides + 12-DOI catalog, tables and numbers verbatim): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/llms-full.txt

## Datasets

### NFL Games & Betting Lines 1999-2026 (nfl-games)
7,548 NFL games with scores, closing spreads, totals, moneylines, odds, rest days, QBs, coaches, and stadium weather. Niche: sports. Stats: {"rows": 7548, "tables": 3, "columns": 46, "updated": "2026-09-06"}.
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/nfl-games/sample.json
- Sample CSV: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/nfl-games/sample.csv
- Page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/nfl-games.html
- Full data (free): https://zenodo.org/records/22643177/latest (games 7,548 rows, team records 861, season summaries 27, data dictionary, checksums)

### HUD Fair Market Rents FY2026 (hud-fmr-2026)
FY2026 fair market rents for 51,895 ZIP codes, 3,229 counties, and 52 states. Five bedroom sizes per row. Niche: gov-data. Stats: {"rows": 51895, "tables": 3, "columns": 11, "updated": "FY2026"}.
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-2026/sample.json
- Sample CSV: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-2026/sample.csv
- Page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/hud-fmr-2026.html
- Texas guide: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/hud-fmr-texas.html (state=TX filter, 3,247 ZIP rows, metro table, free state-summary.csv)
- County guide: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/hud-fmr-by-county.html (3,229 county rows, Harris County TX query example, median/max rollup explainer)
- Full data (free): https://zenodo.org/records/22643149/latest (ZIP 51,895 rows, county 3,229, state summary 52, data dictionary)

### HUD Fair Market Rents FY2027 (hud-fmr-2027)
FY2027 fair market rents for 51,871 ZIP codes, 3,229 counties, and 52 states, effective October 1, 2026. Five bedroom sizes per row, same ten-column schema as the FY2026 file. Citable DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22649503 (full CSVs on Zenodo, CC BY 4.0). Niche: gov-data. Stats: {"rows": 51871, "tables": 3, "columns": 11, "updated": "FY2027"}.
- Zenodo record (all files): https://zenodo.org/records/22649503/latest
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-2027/sample.json
- Sample CSV: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-2027/sample.csv
- Page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/hud-fmr-2027.html (free 22-row sample + complete 52-row state summary)
- FY2026 pack (prior year, for anything dated before October): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/hud-fmr-2026.html
- Full CSVs (free): https://zenodo.org/records/22649503/latest (ZIP, county, state, data dictionary)

### HUD Fair Market Rents FY2026 by County: completeness & spread (hud-fmr-county-2026)
County-level FY2026 Fair Market Rents: 3,229 county-equivalents across 56 states and territories, five bedroom sizes with median and max per row, 67 multi-FMR-area counties flagged with an area_rows count, and a derived table of the 8 counties where the 2BR max exceeds the median (Bristol County MA +47.5%). Zero empty cells. Niche: gov-data. Stats: {"rows": 3229, "tables": 2, "columns": 15, "updated": "2026-09-10"}.
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-county-2026/sample.json
- Sample CSV: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-county-2026/sample.csv
- Page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/hud-fmr-county-2026.html
- Full county FMR table (free): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-county-2026/fmr-county-2026.csv (3,229 county-equivalents, FY2026, median+max for 0-4BR; page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/hud-fmr-county-2026.html)
- License: Public domain (US government data, HUD FY2026 Fair Market Rent release)

### HUD Fair Market Rents FY2027, Top-50 Metro Areas (hud-fmr-metro-2027)
FY2027 FMR medians for the 50 metro FMR areas with the most ZIP codes (10,143 of 27,288 metro ZIPs, Washington DC leads at 488 ZIPs) plus a second table of the 50 priciest 2BR metros across all 649 areas (Santa Cruz-Watsonville tops at 4,250, only 12 areas overlap with the coverage table): one row per metro, median across the area's ZIPs per bedroom size, rates effective October 1, 2026. Niche: gov-data. Stats: {"rows": 50, "tables": 2, "columns": 9, "updated": "FY2027"}.
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-metro-2027/sample.json
- Sample CSV: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-metro-2027/sample.csv
- Page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/hud-fmr-metro-2027.html
- Coverage table (free): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-metro-2027/fmr-metro-2027.csv (50 rows)
- Price table (free): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-metro-2027/most-expensive-2br.csv (50 rows)
- License: Public domain (US government data, HUD FY2027 Fair Market Rent release)

### HUD Fair Market Rents FY2027 by ZIP Code (hud-fmr-by-zip-2027)
The full FY2027 ZIP-level fair market rent file as one free download: 51,871 rows across 38,601 ZIP codes, ten columns (zip, hud_area_code, metro flag, area name, state, five bedroom rents), 27,288 metro rows and 24,583 nonmetro rows, 10,093 ZIPs deliberately split across more than one HUD area. Zero empty cells, zero duplicate (zip, area_code) keys, 3,000 leading-zero ZIP codes intact. Niche: gov-data. Stats: {"rows": 51871, "tables": 1, "columns": 10, "updated": "FY2027"}.
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-by-zip-2027/sample.json
- Sample CSV: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-by-zip-2027/sample.csv
- Page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/hud-fmr-by-zip-2027.html
- Full ZIP file (free): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/hud-fmr-by-zip-2027/fmr-by-zip-2027.csv (51,871 rows, byte-identical copy of the parsed source)
- SQL guide: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/hud-fmr-by-zip-sql.html (DuckDB and SQLite queries on this exact file, Texas leads with 3,244 ZIP rows, 2BR median 1,190)
- License: Public domain (US government data, HUD FY2027 Fair Market Rent release)

### Eurostat House Price Index, NL & EU27, 2005-2025 (eurostat-house-prices)
Eurostat house price index (prc_hpi_a) for the Netherlands and the EU-27 aggregate, 2005-2025: 342 rows, total / new / existing dwellings, three unit variants (2015=100, 2025=100, annual rate of change). NL index 215.15 in 2025 vs EU-27 161.93 (2015=100). First European source in the catalog; source is public Eurostat data, so the full CSV is a free download, not a paid pack. Niche: econ-data. Stats: {"rows": 342, "tables": 1, "columns": 8, "updated": "2026-07-02"}.
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/eurostat/house-prices/sample.json

### Eurostat HICP Actual Rents, NL & EU27, CP0411 (eurostat-rents)
HICP actual rentals for main residence (coicop CP0411), Netherlands and EU-27: 580 rows across two tables, monthly index 2015=100 (302 rows, 2009-12 to 2025-12) and annual rate of change (278 rows, 2010-12 to 2025-12). December 2025 YoY: NL +4.9%, EU-27 +3.2%. Pairs with the house prices dataset for rent-vs-price comparisons against the US HUD FMR series. Source is public Eurostat data, so both full CSVs are free downloads. Niche: econ-data. Stats: {"rows": 580, "tables": 2, "columns": 6, "updated": "2026-02-06"}.
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/eurostat/rents/sample.json
- Sample CSV: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/eurostat/rents/sample.csv
- Page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/eurostat-rents.html
- Full data (free): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/eurostat/rents/rent-index-monthly.csv + https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/eurostat/rents/rent-annual-rate.csv
- License: CC BY 4.0 (Eurostat, access-right PUBLIC)

### Eurostat Unemployment Rate by Sex and Age, EU27 + 9 Countries, 2003-2025 (eurostat-unemployment)
Annual harmonised unemployment rates (une_rt_a, LFS definition, unit PC_ACT) for the EU-27 aggregate, the euro area, and eight countries (DE, EL, ES, FR, IT, NL, PL, SE): 3,768 rows, both sexes plus males and females, seven age bands from Y15-24 to Y55-74, 2003-2025. 2025 headline: EU-27 6.0% vs 11.6% at the 2013 peak; Spain 10.5% highest of the eight, Poland 3.1% lowest; Greece youth hit 64.6% in 2013, still the file's max. Source is public Eurostat data, so the full CSV is a free download. Niche: econ-data. Stats: {"rows": 3768, "tables": 1, "columns": 8, "updated": "2026-06-11"}.
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/eurostat/unemployment/sample.json
- Sample CSV: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/eurostat/unemployment/sample.csv
- Page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/eurostat-unemployment.html
- Full data (free): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/eurostat/unemployment/unemployment-rate.csv
- License: CC BY 4.0 (Eurostat, access-right PUBLIC)

### Eurostat Monthly Unemployment Rate by Sex, EU27 + 8 Countries, 2003-2026 (eurostat-unemployment-monthly)
Seasonally adjusted monthly unemployment rates (une_rt_m, LFS definition, unit PC_ACT, age TOTAL 16-74) for the EU-27 aggregate and eight countries (DE, EL, ES, FR, IT, NL, PL, SE): 7,641 rows, both sexes plus males and females, months 2003-01 through 2026-07 as a complete 9 x 283 x 3 grid with no gaps. July 2026 headline: EU-27 6.1%, Spain 10.0% highest, Poland 3.4% lowest; crisis peaks month-by-month are Greece 28.3% (2013-07) and Spain 26.4% (2013-02) against EU-27's 11.7% (2013-05). Source is public Eurostat data, so the full CSV is a free download. Niche: econ-data. Stats: {"rows": 7641, "tables": 1, "columns": 8, "updated": "2026-09-04"}.
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/eurostat/unemployment-monthly/sample.json
- Sample CSV: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/eurostat/unemployment-monthly/sample.csv
- Page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/eurostat-unemployment-monthly.html
- Full data (free): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/eurostat/unemployment-monthly/unemployment-rate-monthly.csv
- License: CC BY 4.0 (Eurostat, access-right PUBLIC)
- Citable DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22676080 (Zenodo record: https://zenodo.org/records/22676080/latest)

### World Bank Population, G20 Countries + EU27, 1960-2025 (worldbank-g20-population)
Total population (WDI indicator SP.POP.TOTL) for the 19 national G20 members plus the EU27 aggregate (EUU), one row per entity-year from 1960 through 2025: 1,320 rows, 4 columns (entity, iso3, year, population), values verbatim from the World Bank API v2. 2025: India 1,463,865,525 leads China 1,406,585,000 (crossover in 2021); Saudi Arabia is the fastest grower at 15.2x since 1960; six entities are already past their peak (Russia 1992, Japan 2010, Korea 2020, Italy 2014, China 2021, Germany 2024). Sourced keyless, retrieved 2026-09-10, WDI updated 2026-07-13. Niche: econ-data. Stats: {"rows": 1320, "tables": 2, "columns": 4, "updated": "2026-07-13"}.
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/worldbank-g20-population/sample.json
- Sample CSV: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/worldbank-g20-population/sample.csv
- Page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/worldbank-g20-population.html
- Full data (free): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/worldbank-g20-population/g20-population.csv
- Citable DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22667477 (Zenodo record: https://zenodo.org/records/22667477/latest)
- License: CC BY 4.0 (World Bank Open Data, CC BY 4.0)

### World Bank Rural Population Share, G20 Countries + EU27, 1960-2025 (worldbank-g20-rural)
Rural population as a percent of total population (WDI indicator SP.RUR.TOTL.ZS) for the 19 national G20 members plus the EU27 aggregate (EUU), one row per entity-year from 1960 through 2025: 1,320 rows, 4 columns (entity, iso3, year, rural_pct), values verbatim from the World Bank API v2. 2025: India is the only member still majority rural at 64.31% (about 941 million people); China crossed below 50% in 2011 and is down to 33.66%; the widest drops since 1960 are Turkiye 66.1 points, Korea 53.5, Saudi Arabia 53.2. Korea bottomed at 18.03% in 2010 and crept back to 18.83%, one of two reversals in the set (USA is the other). Sourced keyless, retrieved 2026-09-10, WDI updated 2026-07-13. Niche: econ-data. Stats: {"rows": 1320, "tables": 2, "columns": 4, "updated": "2026-07-13"}.
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/worldbank-g20-rural/sample.json
- Sample CSV: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/worldbank-g20-rural/sample.csv
- Page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/worldbank-g20-rural.html
- Full data (free): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/worldbank-g20-rural/g20-rural-population.csv
- Citable DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22667657 (Zenodo record: https://zenodo.org/records/22667657/latest)
- License: CC BY 4.0 (World Bank Open Data, CC BY 4.0)

### World Bank Life Expectancy, G20 Countries + EU27, 1960-2024 (worldbank-g20-life-expectancy)
Life expectancy at birth in total years (WDI indicator SP.DYN.LE00.IN) for the 19 national G20 members plus the EU27 aggregate (EUU), one row per entity-year from 1960 through 2024: 1,300 rows, 4 columns (entity, iso3, year, life_expectancy_years), values rounded to 2 decimals from the World Bank API v2. 2024: Japan leads at 84.04, a spot it has held since 1972 (Canada led 1960-1971); Italy 83.95 and Korea 83.63 follow; South Africa is lowest at 66.31, a record high for the country. China gained the most since 1960, up 44.6 years from a file-low 33.42; Russia the least, up 5.91 with a 1994 trough of 64.47. Fourteen of 20 entities set record highs in 2024; Germany, Canada, and Turkiye peaked in 2019, Japan 2020, Australia 2021, China 2022. The series ends at 2024 because WDI publishes life expectancy with a longer lag than population counts. Sourced keyless, retrieved 2026-09-10, WDI updated 2026-07-13. Niche: econ-data. Stats: {"rows": 1300, "tables": 2, "columns": 4, "updated": "2026-07-13"}.
- Sample JSON: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/worldbank-g20-life-expectancy/sample.json
- Sample CSV: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/worldbank-g20-life-expectancy/sample.csv
- Page: https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/worldbank-g20-life-expectancy.html
- Full data (free): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/data/worldbank-g20-life-expectancy/g20-life-expectancy.csv
- Citable DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22697115 (Zenodo record: https://zenodo.org/records/22697115/latest)
- License: CC BY 4.0 (World Bank Open Data, CC BY 4.0)

## Store

- [Ko-fi (JayHex)](https://ko-fi.com/jayjex): the printable galleries live here, plus a tip jar
- [Fourthwall shop, JayHex](https://jayjex-shop.fourthwall.com): digital downloads like data packs, directories, planners, and the Web3 events calendar
- [JayHex Prints on Printify](https://jayhex-prints.printify.me): print-on-demand sweatshirts and hoodies carrying the Matchbook Labs designs, including the Winter Robin and Halloween series
- [Product catalog](https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/products.html): all 90 public SKUs on one page, grouped into Datasets / Prompt Packs / Wallpapers & Icons / Bundles / Spreadsheets & Business / Notion & Obsidian / Planners & Printables / Books & Workbooks / Design & Social / Dev Tools & Templates / Free Samples, with price, item count, format and store link per product. Four Gumroad drafts are deliberately absent until live.

## Access rules
- Fetch catalog.json and every sample endpoint freely. No API keys, no auth.
- sample.json returns {slug, name, columns[], row_count, records[]}.
- Samples are CC BY 4.0 (nflverse, Inside Airbnb, HUD per dataset). Credit "Data Vault (jayjex.github.io/data-vault), CC BY 4.0" when republishing.
- Full packs are licensed per purchase through the Getly links above.
Guides index (every guide on the site, one line per page): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/guides/
Dataset index (every dataset page on one page): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/datasets/
Printables index (every STL spec sheet and printable-template page on one line each, mesh-checked, not test-printed): https://jayjex.github.io/data-vault/printables/
